$comment: Marathi seed bundle. NOT a replacement for the Phase 5 locale registry — the control plane overrides every key here, and adding a locale there still needs no code change. This exists because a deployment in Pune should not greet its citizens in English while somebody gets round to filling the registry, and because §E10.1 makes Devanagari a design partner rather than a fallback: a type scale with no Devanagari text in it is a type scale nobody has actually looked at. Coverage is deliberately partial — untranslated keys fall through to the source language, which is the normal state of a translation effort and is why mergeBundles overrides rather than replaces.
